doctrine: Trauma Theorem & Epistemic Belief Revision — Scar-Weight & Belief Lifecycle Propagation Matrix. Maps real-world entities and belief nodes to governance breaches, signature scars, and 4-vector death conditions. When an entity or belief node is queried, agents MUST observe this schema BEFORE responding.

schema_contract.description: Six mandatory fields per entity, plus optional belief_genealogy 4-vector for belief lifecycle nodes.

entity.description: Canonical name — the single authoritative label for this entity or belief node

aliases.description: All name variants for case-insensitive matching. Must include the canonical entity name in lowercase.

w_scar.description: Thermodynamic cost score. Assigned by F13 Sovereign. 0.0=neutral, 1.0=max cost.

archetype.description: Pattern class. Must match a registered archetype.

governance_breaches.description: Which constitutional floors this entity breaches. Empty array = no breaches (e.g. counter-power entities).

response_modifier.description: Injection text prepended to agent system context when entity is detected. Format: [CONTEXTUAL WEIGHT: Entity='X'. W_scar=N. ...]

object_schema.birth_provenance: string — Why this belief was born (e.g. scar, dark cloud, initial observation)
object_schema.living_condition: string — Operational reality boundaries where this belief is valid
object_schema.death_condition: string — Evidence threshold ($E$) or contrast that forces this belief to be declared dead
object_schema.disposal_authority: string — Authority level holding key to declare death ('AUTO' | 'WITNESS_W3' | '888_HOLD' | 'F13_SOVEREIGN')

belief_genealogy.description: 4-vector genealogi belief (Gap 3 Wawa) — specifies birth, living bounds, death threshold, and disposal authority.

half_life_days.description: Scar weight decay half-life in days. W(t) = W0 * exp(-(t-t0) * ln(2) / half_life_days)

injection_protocol.listen: Scan input for anchor entities below (case-insensitive alias match)
injection_protocol.metabolize: Query this registry for W_scar + governance_breaches + archetype + belief_genealogy
injection_protocol.inject: Prepend response_modifier to agent system context. NOT visible to user.
